beliefs: The box shifts each character forward by 8 codepoints, applied independently per character [E1, E2, E3, E6, E8]
The shift applies uniformly across ASCII, Latin-1, and multi-byte ranges including surrogates and near U+10FFFF [E6, E8]
The character 't' (0x74) is a special case: it maps to '(' (0x28) instead of the usual 0x7C [E4, E11]
All other characters including '|' (0x7C -> 0x84) and '~' (0x7E -> 0x86) follow the uniform +8 rule [E7, E9, E10, E11]
notes: E11 revealed the mismatch was 't'->'(' not '|'->'(': the model's '|' prediction came from 't'+8, and '|' itself maps normally to 0x84 (E7, E11 output 2). Added 't' as a single special case.
